reader_conclusion: The tested intergrown cathode shows strong capacity/rate and near-zero-strain behavior; the broader design-space claim extends beyond the finite tested composition series.

claims.content: Li1.2Ni0.4Ru0.4O2 delivered 244 mAh g−1 and 904 Wh kg−1 between 4.6 and 2.5 V, with about 200 and 165 mAh g−1 at C/2 and 1C, respectively.

evidence_relations.reason: The galvanostatic tests directly report the bounded performance figures.

support.reason: The performance values are directly reported under explicit voltage and rate conditions.

claims.content: The layered-rocksalt intergrown material exhibited nearly zero-strain structural evolution during high-capacity cycling.

evidence_relations.reason: Structural characterization directly bears on the bounded zero-strain behavior.

support.reason: The source directly reports suppression of anisotropic structural change for the tested composition.

claims.content: Layered-rocksalt intergrowth is a broadly applicable cathode design principle opening a vast composition space for high-performance electrodes.

evidence_relations.reason: The focal material supplies one direct realization.
Additional tested compositions extend the concept, but a finite series cannot establish the whole proposed design space.

support.reason: The composition series supports transfer beyond one formulation, but broad design-space performance remains a generalization.

reasoning_edges.added_reach: Extends successful behavior in the tested composition series to a broad cathode-design space.
assumptions: The tested compositions adequately represent the wider design space.

usable.results: Capacity/rate and structural-strain measurements are reusable at the reported conditions.
usable.methods_or_design: Coupled electrochemical and structural characterization is useful for testing intergrowth hypotheses.
usable.materials_or_documentation: Composition, cycling windows, rates, and structural observations are explicit.

downweight.worth_noticing: The additional composition series materially strengthens the design argument.
downweight.cautious_or_ignore: Do not convert a finite successful series into proof of the whole proposed composition space.

uncertainty_and_follow_up: Broader composition coverage, longer cycling, and independent material systems would test generality.
